Here's a complete, self-contained dashboard. It leans into a "bookshop ledger" identity — a warm paper-and-ink light theme with a deep-ink dark theme, a Fraunces display face paired with IBM Plex Sans/Mono, and a live canvas chart that animates on load.

```html

  {title:"The Orchard of Forgotten Names", author:"Beatrice Lang", year:2016, price:15.00, stock:10, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"Notes on a Vanishing City", author:"Viktor Petrov", year:2020, price:18.25, stock:1, genre:"Non-fiction"},

  {title:"The Cartography of Memory", author:"Lena Fischer", year:2021, price:21.00, stock:5, genre:"Non-fiction"},
  {title:"A Map of Small Wonders", author:"Theo Nakamura", year:2015, price:10.50, stock:28, genre:"Children"},
  {title:"The Hollow Crown of Ash", author:"Rowan Ashford", year:2022, price:19.50, stock:7, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"Letters to a Stranger", author:"Clara Vane", year:2014, price:13.75, stock:9, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"The Geometry of Longing", author:"Dr. Omar Haddad", year:2020, price:23.00, stock:3, genre:"Philosophy"},
  {title:"The Nightingale's Ledger", author:"Petra Novak", year:2018, price:15.25, stock:16, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"Saltwater Psalms", author:"Dylan O'Shea", year:2019, price:14.00, stock:0, genre:"Poetry"},
  {title:"The Inheritance of Light", author:"Amara Okafor", year:2023, price:17.00, stock:12, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"A Short History of Silence", author:"Henrik Lund", year:2016, price:16.25, stock:6, genre:"Non-fiction"},
  {title:"The Foxglove Case", author:"Margot Ellison", year:2021, price:18.50, stock:4, genre:"Mystery"},
  {title:"Where the Rivers Remember", author:"Sylvia Chen", year:2017, price:15.50, stock:19, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"The Alchemist's Apprentice", author:"Gabriel Fontaine", year:2015, price:12.75, stock:11, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"On the Nature of Forgetting", author:"Dr. Ines Almeida", year:2022, price:24.50, stock:2, genre:"Philosophy"},
  {title:"The Little Book of Tides", author:"Freya Holm", year:2013, price:8.99, stock:34, genre:"Children"},
  {title:"The Cartographer's Ghost", author:"Elias Thorn", year:2020, price:17.25, stock:8, genre:"Mystery"},
  {title:"A Season of Small Fires", author:"Nadia Rahman", year:2019, price:14.75, stock:15, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"The Weight of Water", author:"Jonas Weber", year:2018, price:16.00, stock:5, genre:"Non-fiction"},
  {title:"The Last Letter Home", author:"Ruth Calloway", year:2016, price:13.00, stock:20, genre:"Fiction"},
  {title:"The Unmapped Coast", author:"Diego Marín", year:2021, price:19.00, stock:3, genre:"History"},
  {title:"Songs for the Drowned", author:"Elif Demir", year:2023, price:15.00, stock:10, genre:"Poetry"}
];

/* ---------- State ---------- */
const state = { sortKey:"title", sortDir:1, page:1, perPage:8,
  search:"", genre:"all", year:"", stock:"all" };

const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const tbody = $("#tbody");
const money = n => "$" + n.toFixed(2);

/* ---------- Filtering ---------- */
function getFiltered(){
  const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
  return BOOKS.filter(b=>{
    if(q && !(b.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || b.author.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
    if(state.genre !== "all" && b.genre !== state.genre) return false;
    if(state.year && b.year < +state.year) return false;
    if(state.stock === "in"  && b.stock <= 0) return false;
    if(state.stock === "low" && !(b.stock > 0 && b.stock <= 5)) return false;
    if(state.stock === "out" && b.stock !== 0) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

/* ---------- Sorting ---------- */
function sortRows(rows){
  const k = state.sortKey, d = state.sortDir;
  return rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>{
    let x = a[k], y = b[k];
    if(typeof x === "string"){ x = x.toLowerCase(); y = y.toLowerCase(); }
    return x < y ? -d : x > y ? d : 0;
  });
}

/* ---------- Render table ---------- */
function stockClass(n){ return n === 0 ? "out" : n <= 5 ? "low" : "in"; }
function renderTable(){
  const rows = sortRows(getFiltered());
  const total = rows.length;
  const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / state.perPage));
  if(state.page > pages) state.page = pages;
  const start = (state.page - 1) * state.perPage;
  const slice = rows.slice(start, start + state.perPage);

  tbody.innerHTML = slice.length ? slice.map(b=>`
    <tr>
      <td class="b-title">${b.title}</td>
      <td class="b-author">${b.author}</td>
      <td class="num">${b.year}</td>
      <td class="num price">${money(b.price)}</td>
      <td><span class="stock ${stockClass(b.stock)}"><span class="pip"></span>${b.stock === 0 ? "out" : b.stock}</span></td>
    </tr>`).join("")
    : `<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No titles match your filters.</td></tr>`;

  $("#pagerInfo").textContent = total
    ? `Showing ${start+1}–${start+slice.length} of ${total}`
    : "No results";
  renderPager(pages);
  updateSortArrows();
}

/* ---------- Pagination ---------- */
function renderPager(pages){
  const wrap = $("#pagerBtns");
  let html = `<button data-p="prev" ${state.page===1?"disabled":""}>‹</button>`;
  for(let i=1;i<=pages;i++){
    html += `<button data-p="${i}" class="${i===state.page?"active":""}">${i}</button>`;
  }
  html += `<button data-p="next" ${state.page===pages?"disabled":""}>›</button>`;
  wrap.innerHTML = html;
}

/* ---------- Sort arrows ---------- */
function updateSortArrows(){
  document.querySelectorAll("th.sortable").forEach(th=>{
    const on = th.dataset.key === state.sortKey;
    th.classList.toggle("sorted", on);
    th.querySelector(".arrow").textContent = on ? (state.sortDir===1?"↑":"↓") : "↕";
  });
}

/* ---------- Summary cards ---------- */
function animateNumber(el, to, fmt){
  const from = 0, dur = 700, t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(t){
    const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0)/dur);
    const e = 1 - Math.pow(1-p, 3);
    el.textContent = fmt(from + (to-from)*e);
    if(p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  })(t0);
}
function updateCards(){
  const units = BOOKS.reduce((s,b)=>s+b.stock,0);
  const value = BOOKS.reduce((s,b)=>s+b.stock*b.price,0);
  const low = BOOKS.filter(b=>b.stock>0 && b.stock<=5).length;
  const out = BOOKS.filter(b=>b.stock===0).length;
  animateNumber($("#cTitles"), BOOKS.length, v=>Math.round(v));
  animateNumber($("#cUnits"), units, v=>Math.round(v).toLocaleString());
  animateNumber($("#cValue"), value, v=>"$"+Math.round(v).toLocaleString());
  animateNumber($("#cLow"), low+out, v=>Math.round(v));
}

/* ---------- Canvas bar chart ---------- */
const canvas = $("#chart");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
let chartData = [], chartAnim = 0;

function genreTotals(){
  const map = {};
  BOOKS.forEach(b=>{ map[b.genre] = (map[b.genre]||0) + b.stock; });
  return Object.entries(map).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
}
function cssVar(name){ return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim(); }

function drawChart(){
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
  canvas.width = w*dpr; canvas.height = h*dpr;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);

  const pad = {l:44, r:14, t:16, b:34};
  const plotW = w - pad.l - pad.r, plotH = h - pad.t - pad.b;
  const max = Math.max(...chartData.map(d=>d.value), 1);
  const niceMax = Math.ceil(max/10)*10;
  const ink = cssVar("--ink"), faint = cssVar("--ink-faint"), line = cssVar("--line");
  const palette = [cssVar("--accent"), cssVar("--accent-2"), cssVar("--gold"),
                   cssVar("--ink"), "#7a5aa0", "#3f7fa6", "#a06a3a", "#5a7a3a"];

  // gridlines + y labels
  ctx.font = "11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
  ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
    const val = niceMax * i/4;
    const y = pad.t + plotH - (val/niceMax)*plotH;
    ctx.strokeStyle = line; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.l, y); ctx.lineTo(w-pad.r, y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = faint; ctx.fillText(Math.round(val), pad.l-8, y);
  }

  const n = chartData.length;
  const gap = 14;
  const bw = (plotW - gap*(n-1)) / n;
  const e = 1 - Math.pow(1-chartAnim, 3);

  chartData.forEach((d,i)=>{
    const x = pad.l + i*(bw+gap);
    const bh = (d.value/niceMax)*plotH*e;
    const y = pad.t + plotH - bh;
    const col = palette[i % palette.length];
    ctx.fillStyle = col;
    roundRect(ctx, x, y, bw, bh, 5); ctx.fill();
    // value label
    ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    ctx.font = "600 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(Math.round(d.value*e), x+bw/2, y-4);
    // x label
    ctx.fillStyle = faint; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.font = "10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace";
    ctx.fillText(d.label, x+bw/2, pad.t+plotH+8);
  });
}
function roundRect(c,x,y,w,h,r){
  r = Math.min(r, w/2, h/2);
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(x+r,y); c.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r); c.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
  c.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r); c.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r); c.closePath();
}
function animateChart(){
  chartAnim = 0;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(t){
    chartAnim = Math.min(1, (t-t0)/800);
    drawChart();
    if(chartAnim < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  })(t0);
}
function buildLegend(){
  const palette = [cssVar("--accent"), cssVar("--accent-2"), cssVar("--gold"),
                   cssVar("--ink"), "#7a5aa0", "#3f7fa6", "#a06a3a", "#5a7a3a"];
  $("#legend").innerHTML = chartData.map((d,i)=>
    `<span><i style="background:${palette[i%palette.length]}"></i>${d.label} · ${d.value}</span>`).join("");
}

/* ---------- Theme ---------- */
function setTheme(t){
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
  $("#themeIco").textContent = t === "dark" ? "☀" : "☾";
  $("#themeTxt").textContent = t === "dark" ? "Light" : "Dark";
  drawChart(); // recolor bars to new palette
}
$("#themeToggle").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
  const cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme");
  setTheme(cur === "dark" ? "light" : "dark");
});

/* ---------- Events ---------- */
$("#fSearch").addEventListener("input", e=>{ state.search = e.target.value; state.page = 1; renderTable(); });
$("#fGenre").addEventListener("change", e=>{ state.genre = e.target.value; state.page = 1; renderTable(); });
$("#fYear").addEventListener("input", e=>{ state.year = e.target.value; state.page = 1; renderTable(); });
$("#fStock").addEventListener("change", e=>{ state.stock = e.target.value; state.page = 1; renderTable(); });
$("#filterForm").addEventListener("reset", ()=>{
  state.search=""; state.genre="all"; state.year=""; state.stock="all"; state.page=1;
  renderTable();
});
document.querySelectorAll("th.sortable").forEach(th=>{
  th.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    const k = th.dataset.key;
    if(state.sortKey === k) state.sortDir *= -1;
    else { state.sortKey = k; state.sortDir = 1; }
    renderTable();
  });
});
$("#pagerBtns").addEventListener("click", e=>{
  const b = e.target.closest("button"); if(!b || b.disabled) return;
  const p = b.dataset.p;
  if(p === "prev") state.page--;
  else if(p === "next") state.page++;
  else state.page = +p;
  renderTable();
});
let rt;
window.addEventListener("resize", ()=>{ clearTimeout(rt); rt = setTimeout(drawChart, 120); });

/* ---------- Clock ---------- */
function tick(){
  const d = new Date();
  $("#clock").textContent = d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{weekday:"short",day:"numeric",month:"short"})
    + " · " + d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined,{hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
}
tick(); setInterval(tick, 1000);
$("#yearNow").textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

/* ---------- Init ---------- */
chartData = genreTotals();
buildLegend();
updateCards();
renderTable();
animateChart();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

**How the parts fit together:** the semantic shell (`header` / `nav` / `main` / `footer`) is laid out by a single CSS grid with named areas, so the sidebar, content and footer reflow cleanly across the three breakpoints (cards collapse 4→2→1, the sidebar becomes a horizontal strip, and the filter form stacks). All the data lives in one `BOOKS` array plus a `state` object; the filter form, sortable column headers and pagination buttons all just mutate that state and call `renderTable()`, which re-filters, re-sorts and re-slices the rows — so every control stays in sync automatically. The four summary cards and the canvas bar chart are derived from the same data (totals and per-genre stock), and the theme toggle simply flips a `data-theme` attribute that swaps the CSS variables, with the chart redrawing to pick up the new palette.
